notes.title: It's been 1 year since the release of Rivalia: Dungeon Raiders!!!! 🥳
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649594/a2375727a7bcaa585d8ddf0a0a4c4745b51e8762.png[/img]

[h1]It's been 1 year since the release of Rivalia: Dungeon Raiders!!!! 🥳[/h1]

It's been 1 year since the release of Rivalia: Dungeon Raiders!!!! 🥳

Un año de lleno de mazmorras, demonios y nigromancia, pero sobre todo... ¡De caos, locura y diversión! ⚔🎭

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649594/5c968445c497616cfed776fb3b978e4b173c7b33.png[/img]

Rivalia: Dungeon Riders is a [b]roguelike with action-RPG[/b] gameplay in which we take control of a group of [b]heroes trapped in a time loop[/b] who must break the curse that grips the castle. Choose between [b]Ashelin, Halmor, Yhorm and Evanya[/b] and switch between them at any time in a totally organic way as you advance through [b]6 procedurally generated[/b] levels, loaded with [b]action, traps and challenges of all kinds[/b] as you hunt down Ciceron and his minions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649594/042edc4ed801a6fc7e22c125532ffff33ddc1f58.png[/img]

[b]Featured content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Break the curse of Rivalia's castle throughout [b]6 procedurally generated levels[/b].
[*] Enjoy completely original games every time you start over, thanks to the game's [b]randomized dungeon system[/b].
[*] Switch instantly between [b]4 heroes with completely different personalities and skills[/b] and discover the most effective strategies to fight against every enemy and boss that will try to prevent your progress.
[*] Get [b]resources and materials[/b] with which to [b]create powerful upgrades[/b] that will help you emerge victorious.
[*] Enjoy the [b] lighthearted tone and cartoon aesthetics[/b] based on your [b]favorite role-playing games[/b] and stop the feet of the diabolical Ciceron.
[*] [b]Now available on [url=https://store.playstation.com/es-es/product/EP0811-CUSA27721_00-8929387558275941]PS4[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1872500/Rivalia_Dungeon_Raiders/]Steam.[/url][/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Rivalia's spooky 1.02 update is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Halloween event details[/h1]
[list]
[*] The event will be available from the 24th of October until the 2nd of November.
[*] The lobby will be decorated with the event's own aesthetics.
[*] Enemies that inhabit the graveyard will change their appearance to fit the festival.
[*] The graveyard dungeons will also be decorated with new details, such as pumpkins and ravens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649594/c81fa41ae5e3c2f3db39441c874499cdb20d12c7.png[/img]

[*] Among these new decorations, there will be breakable pumpkins that will contain 2 new materials exclusive to this event: Pumpkin and Silver Ingot.
[*] Using the new materials will unlock 2 new exclusive rune sets available for forging: Pumpkin Rune and Moon Rune.
[*] Once the event is over, you will keep the materials and runes obtained. The event's exclusive runes will still be available for forging in the forge, but you will no longer be able to obtain materials within the dungeons.
[/list]

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] If you select the controller as the default device and is disconnected, the mouse and keyboard controls will be activated until the controller is connected again.
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased Sacrum's magic damage and health. Increased health of Skeletons summoned by Sacrum.
[*] Increased physical damage and health of Spinefeld and Marrow.
[*] Increased Ciceron's physical and magic damage and reduced his armour.
[*] Reduced magic damage of Flying Cyclops.
[/list]
